data.notes: August 2026 is unusually dense for Malta, with major electronic programming around Ta’ Qali, Gianpula Village and Café del Mar plus large-scale pop concerts at Ta’ Qali.

events.title: Glitch Festival 2026
events.summary: Glitch Festival marks its 10-year anniversary with a 12–15 August edition in Malta and 95+ acts across its underground house and techno programme.

events.title: SummerDaze Malta: Calvin Harris
events.summary: Calvin Harris headlines SummerDaze Malta’s second Ta’ Qali main event, presented in collaboration with BBC Radio 1 Dance Anthems and Creamfields.

events.title: SummerDaze Malta: Lewis Capaldi
events.summary: Lewis Capaldi headlines the first of SummerDaze Malta’s two 2026 Ta’ Qali headline shows.

events.title: Music On Malta 2026
events.summary: Marco Carola’s Music On lands in Malta for the first time with Marco Carola, East End Dubs, Franky Rizardo, Ilario Alicante, Joey Daniel, Mason Collective, Ant Mifsud and Ares Carter listed for a 16:00–04:00 event.

events.title: Pitbull: I’m Back with special guest Lil Jon
events.summary: Pitbull brings his I’m Back Tour to Malta with special guest Lil Jon for a large open-air show at Ta’ Qali National Park.

events.title: EXIT Presents: Spiral Festival 2026
events.summary: EXIT’s new Malta festival runs across Gianpula Village, Café del Mar and other island venues, with the ticketing page naming Fatboy Slim, Nina Kraviz, Lilly Palmer and Argy-led programming across the weekend.

events.title: UNO Malta presents Carl Cox
events.summary: Carl Cox returns to UNO Malta for a one-night open-air club event billed by the venue as “The King Is Back.”

events.title: Music On Malta
events.summary: Marco Carola’s Music On brand makes its Malta debut with a 12-hour house, techno and tech-house takeover featuring Marco Carola, East End Dubs, Franky Rizardo, Ilario Alicante, Joey Daniel, Mason Collective, Ant Mifsud and Ares Carter.

events.title: Panorama Malta & G7 Events Present: ARTBAT at Café del Mar
events.summary: ARTBAT headline a Panorama Malta showcase at Café del Mar, billed as an immersive melodic techno night from 20:00 onwards.

events.title: Steve Aoki Live at Gianpula Village
events.summary: Steve Aoki returns to Gianpula Village for a late-night headline DJ show promoted by G7 Events.

events.title: Cocoricò presents Galactica Malta - August Residency
events.summary: Cocoricò’s Galactica hard-techno residency continues at UNO Malta across August dates, with confirmed sessions listed for 7, 13, 21 and 28 August 2026.

events.title: MEDUZA at Café del Mar Malta
events.summary: MEDUZA headline a seaside electronic session at Café del Mar Malta, with Carl Bee also listed on the Resident Advisor event page.

events.title: Cocoricò Pres. Galactica Malta
events.summary: Cocoricò’s Galactica takes over UNO for a special Thursday date within its 2026 Malta summer residency, focused on hard techno and hypnotic club sounds.

events.title: Spiral Festival Day 2 at Café del Mar ft. Argy
events.summary: A Saturday sunset/late-night Spiral Festival session at Café del Mar with Argy and Layla Benitez, positioned as the techno-focused beach-club day of the new EXIT-linked Malta festival weekend.

events.title: G7 Events & District Presents: Claptone at Café del Mar
events.summary: Claptone headlines a G7 Events and District sunset-to-night edition at Café del Mar Malta on 14 August.

events.title: Afro Island & Soul Sessions – The Secret Garden
events.summary: Afro Island teams with Soul Sessions for an open-air two-room night: Afro Island hosts Afro and R&B in Room 2 while Soul Sessions leads the main room with soulful house and tribal sounds, plus Afrobeats, hip-hop, amapiano and dancehall across the bill.

events.title: World Wide Wonders Malta — 7 Clubs Festival
events.summary: A multi-club Gianpula Village concept giving one-ticket access to seven rooms, including techno at Club Phoenix, hip-hop/trap at The Club House, house at Groove Gardens, reggaeton/Latin at The Rooftop and other genre zones.

events.title: Techno Agency x O.S.M.W.S.T.A x T6E RESILIENCE
events.summary: Techno Agency links with O.S.M.W.S.T.A and T6E RESILIENCE at Liquid Club, Malta’s core underground techno venue, for a late-summer progressive house and techno session headlined by Philip Ackowsky.

events.title: Boat Party in Malta - Summerlove
events.summary: A 250-capacity open-bar Sunday boat party from Sliema Ferries with resident DJ sets across R&B, reggaeton and dance-oriented party music.
